recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-19707; future editorial changes to canonical datatype wording should be handled separately from this completed typo correction.
issue_request: FHIR-19707 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 technical correction for the FHIR-core datatypes page. It reported that the canonical datatype description said "A URI that is refers to a resource by it's canonical URL" and asked to remove the extra word "is".
initial_application: The same canonical typo family was first applied through FHIR-19540: commit 2ff0cecf5fa2e072b1183306c98019df81b0f1ca changed source/datatypes.html from "A URI that is refers" to "A URI that refers". The FHIR-19707 Jira comment says the "is" typo was already fixed and points to GH#de65b7ad for fixing "it's"; merge commit de65b7ad7b1acf46921e40d2e404c7be97643921 changed the same row from "resource by it's canonical URL" to "resource by its canonical URL".
additional_context: source/datatypes.html is the core datatype narrative source for canonical; source/fhir.ini maps datatype pages to datatypes.html by default. FHIR-19540 is the same typo family and is already represented on the combined branch by d793a3a17a41e89cb4443d628df77c755f9a2d31, so it was not duplicated. FHIR-19681 is a duplicate report of the same canonical text and was not treated as an independent source-edit decision. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community record.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current source says "A URI that refers to a resource by its canonical URL", satisfying both the requested removal of "is" and the Jira-commented correction from "it's" to "its".
